question: Who became the first Indian space tourist in 2025, joining the crew for Amazon founder Jeff Bezos’ Blue Origin’s NS-25 mission?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Gopi Thotakura**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gopi Thotakura** became the **first Indian space tourist** in 2025 by joining the crew on Amazon founder Jeff Bezos' **Blue Origin’s NS-25 mission.**
 
• This achievement marks a significant milestone for **India** in the field of space exploration and private space tourism.
 
• **Blue Origin** is a private aerospace company founded by **Jeff Bezos** that specializes in **suborbital space tourism** and other space activities.
 
• The **NS-25 mission** is part of Blue Origin’s **New Shepard program**, which focuses on providing commercial suborbital flights for space tourism.
 
• As a space tourist, **Gopi Thotakura** experienced the thrill of traveling to the edge of space, witnessing **zero gravity**, and viewing Earth from space.
 
• This event highlights the growing involvement of Indians in the **global space tourism industry**.
 
• The mission underscores the advancements made by private companies like **Blue Origin** in making space travel accessible to civilians.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shubham Banerjee**__

 __
 
• Shubham Banerjee is known for his **innovative contributions** to technology, particularly in developing a **low-cost Braille printer.**
 
• His achievements have earned him recognition as a **young inventor**, but he is not involved in space tourism.
 
 
 
• **Zoya Agarwal**__
 __
 
• **Zoya Agarwal** is an Indian pilot who gained fame as the **first woman pilot** to command an all-female crew on a flight over the **North Pole.**
 
• She is celebrated for her contributions to aviation but is not related to space tourism.
 
 
 
• **Mohadessa Jafri**__
 
 
• Mohadessa Jafri is a name associated with various fields, including **education** and **entrepreneurship**, but there is no record of her involvement in space tourism.
